7.1.5.2 Goto sleep specific for slave node
This chapter is only applicable for LIN slave nodes.
[SWS_LinSM_00230] ⌈If the state is LINSM_FULL_COM, the ComM requests
COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION; the LinSM shall store the requested communication
mode and return E_OK without further action.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00231] ⌈When LinSM_GotoSleepIndication is called, and the current
state is LINSM_FULL_COM, the LinSM shall directly call LinIf_GotoSleep (and not
wait for next main function call) to enter sleep mode on the requested network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00232] ⌈In all other cases from SWS_LinSM_00231 the LinIf_Goto
Sleep shall not be called.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00233] ⌈When the current state is LINSM_FULL_COM, and the re-
quested communication mode by ComM module is COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION,
LinIf shall call LinIf_GotoSleep and afterwards notifiy ComM of the bus sleep event by
calling ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode for the specified network.⌋
[SWS_LinSM_00234] ⌈In the case of [SWS_LinSM_00046] and the requested com-
munication mode by ComM module is COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION, the LinSM
shall restart the wakeup up process.⌋
